input: Grounded: hold S+G (Down+special), release G; Down may be released first. Air Down+G remains prior no-op.

charge.policy: User correction: continuous source-preserving cosine ping-pong of full 102..156 range, 4.5s cycle, zero-speed turnarounds. Power caps at 2.25s but animation clock continues; no auto-release. Controller planted and vulnerable. Playback time is deliberately eased, not constant source speed.

rush.damage_note: Doge down-special previously no-op; new provisional fixed damage, not borrowed neutral charge scaling
rush.policy: Full tackle source once, mapped to charge-scaled rush duration; 0.08s release crossfade. One packet per opponent; existing team/shield math. Brake-only travel excluded even within a fractional final rush tick. Listed unobstructed distances are measured at 60Hz including braking, not terrain-limited distances.

brake_policy: Smoothstep deceleration during vulnerable non-damaging recovery, 0.18s blend into original Idle. Forward ground/wall stopping-distance anticipation; hard safety clamp has priority. No borrowed Landing clip.

safety.terrain: actual ray terrain excluding all fighters and ignored pass-through platforms; conservative brake on steps/steep slopes instead of jump or hover
safety.walls: native solid capsule plus post-move terrain normals; terrain occlusion before contact damage
safety.interruption: hit freeze grab stock reset controls-disable clear state and target latch; gravity unchanged; no armor or resource refund

animation_contract: Latest installed 18 old animations retained byte-for-byte; append animation-only binary/accessors. 24 bones/full rest matrices verified; all XYZ hip travel anchored to installed rest; source normalized all-bone landmarks checked at 96Hz. No source files modified.
pose_review: Original source pose_sheet.png plus corrected GPU loop/brake evidence: continuous charge weight shift with smooth ping-pong rather than endpoint freeze; full hunched tackle once; original Idle blended for braking. No arbitrary source cuts or source asset edits.
